cohort: 284 neonates admitted to the neonatal intensive care unit at Combined Military Hospital Abbottabad between September 2017 and March 2018
finding: Neonatal sepsis and prematurity were the leading causes of neonatal mortality in the study cohort.
birth_weight: Study included very low birth weight (<1500g), low birth weight (1500-2500g), and normal birth weight (>2500g) infants
